rows.event: Mercury 2 ships: first diffusion reasoning model, ~1,000 tokens/s. Mercury 3 followed on 19 Oct; Google's Gemini Diffusion is still experimental.
rows.meaning: Diffusion is real but not yet at the frontier, so it hasn't been the accelerant the 2026 prompt asked about.

rows.event: METR measures Claude Mythos Preview at a 50% time horizon of at least 16 h, the top of what its task suite can measure.
rows.meaning: The ruler has run out: progress since spring 2026 can't be read off the same scale.

rows.event: Stanford AI Index: employment of developers aged 22–25 down ~20% since late 2022, while older developers' grew.
rows.meaning: The entry-level rung is being hit first — Gemini's 'experience paradox' from your Round 1.

rows.event: Overall developer job postings up ~11% year on year (Indeed); BLS still projects 15% growth to 2034.
rows.meaning: Benchmarks say 'expert'; the job market says AI is a tool most teams still pair with people.

rows.event: METR Frontier Risk Report: labs reported no dramatic research speed-ups (Feb–Mar 2026 window).
rows.meaning: Self-improvement had not yet visibly compounded by spring.

rows.event: SWE-bench Pro tops out near 80% (Claude Mythos 5 80.3%); SWE-bench Verified at 95.5%.
rows.meaning: The main coding benchmarks are close to saturated.

rows.event: OpenAI says it reached its 'automated research intern' goal; agents logged 3.1 workdays per human workday in August. Target for a full automated researcher: March 2028.
rows.meaning: Sage's 2027 self-improvement inflection is arriving roughly on schedule — and by the labs' own account.

rows.event: Quantum: logical qubits in the dozens; reviews put broad quantum speed-ups of AI training several hardware generations away.
rows.meaning: Sage's 2028 quantum boost (350% per six months) looks the least likely part of the model.
